bore_CF_contact_observations.interpretation_rule: Only a complete pair-specific CF report with positive reported area is counted as a positive-area patch; force-bearing patch evidence further requires a finite nonzero CF vector. Zero/missing force by itself is not interpreted as open. CFN is not added to CF.

limits: This is a non-atomic immutable output-prefix snapshot; source execution was still running at capture.
Only accepted pilot.sta times are analyzed. The 20 times stop at 0.020 s; no inference is made about later times or between states.
Absent or partial CF/CFN/CFS output remains unknown and is never replaced by zero.
CFN is not added to CF; it is a duplicate normal-force report. CFS remains a separate report field.
A reported first nonzero bore CF vector or positive area is an output observation, not complete physical seating, capacity, a reaction balance, or a mechanical acceptance result.
Zero or missing CF force alone does not establish an open physical gap.
No CEL or FRD fields were used. CEL was not captured; the FRD file was present in the snapshot but was not read or hashed. No native solve, CAD operation, or live case access was performed.
